key_insight: An AI-generated cell-boundary overlay showed potential to improve consistency in neurologic autoantibody assay interpretation; this study did not investigate cancer drug discovery.
clinical_relevance: The combined overlay and model category may support second-read review of difficult fluorescence images, pending independent validation.
method: Transferred detected cell boundaries from a structural channel onto antibody-staining images.
Compared standalone model classifications with a reader-derived three-class reference.
Had four readers assess held-out records first unaided, then with the overlay and model category.
evidence_signal: Using 2,763 development records and 499 held-out records across 14 antibody targets, the selected model achieved 85.2% reference concordance, with lowest recall for weak-positive or equivocal records.
watch_item: Higher assisted reader agreement may reflect model-directed anchoring: almost all revised ratings moved toward the model category.
paper_title: AI-Assisted Interpretation of Neurologic Autoantibody Cell-Based Assays
